title: He toured the wide world with Hengler’s Royal Circus. I seen him do that in Stockholm.
html_source:
Odysseus: “What truth is there in lies?”

Murphy’s story about Stephen’s father is clearly not true but it does seem to mirror the tall tale that Odysseus invents when he returns to Ithaca in Book 16 “Eumaeus” of the Odyssey.
